semiconductor_relevance: High — Santec Japan specializes in optical measurement technologies crucial for the processing and inspection of optical semiconductors and wafers.
summary: Santec Japan develops and manufactures advanced optical measurement instruments that provide non-contact thickness and flatness measurements for various semiconductor materials. Their products utilize cutting-edge optical technology to achieve sub-nanometer accuracy, making them suitable for applications in wafer processing and inspection.
capabilities: Non-contact wafer thickness and flatness measurement with 1 nm repeatability
Measurement of materials including Si, SiC, GaN, sapphire, and glass
High-Power Spatial Light Modulator for precise beam shaping and control
Integration with automation systems for in-line inspection

regional_presence.Japan: Santec Japan is based in Japan, focusing on the development and manufacturing of optical measurement technologies.
